title: 原位生物整治~In-situ bioremediation
focus: 以電子收支、微生物反應與產物證據判讀原位生物整治~Interpret in-situ bioremediation through electron balances, biological reactions and product evidence
summary: 本課以「以電子收支、微生物反應與產物證據判讀原位生物整治」為主軸，依序處理污染路徑與可處理性、電子供受體收支、接觸時間與水力限制、串聯轉化與中間物累積、停止供應後的反彈。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Interpret in-situ bioremediation through electron balances, biological reactions and product evidence, progressing through Contaminant pathway and treatability, Electron donor/acceptor balance, Contact time and hydraulic constraints, Sequential transformation and intermediate buildup, Rebound after amendment cessation. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 污染路徑與可處理性~Contaminant pathway and treatability
units.mechanism: 先列污染物型態、地下水路徑與電子受供體條件，確認生物可利用性及可能產物再選情境。 線性平衡吸附使溶質平均遷移慢於水；吸附不是污染物破壞。~List contaminant forms, groundwater paths and electron donors and acceptors; assess bioavailability and products before choosing a scenario. Linear equilibrium sorption slows mean solute travel relative to water; sorption is not contaminant destruction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾土體積密度 ρb=1.6 kg/L；Kd=0.5 L/kg；孔隙率 n=0.30。公式 R=1+rho_b*Kd/n，計算得 3.66667 dimensionless。適用邊界：線性、可逆、即時平衡吸附及固定密度孔隙率；不適用強非線性或非平衡拖尾。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry bulk density ρb=1.6 kg/L; Kd=0.5 L/kg; porosity n=0.30. Formula R=1+rho_b*Kd/n gives 3.66667 dimensionless. Applicability: Linear reversible instantaneous equilibrium sorption with fixed density and porosity; not strongly nonlinear or nonequilibrium tailing.
units.verify: 針對「污染路徑與可處理性」，用批次與柱試驗檢查 Kd 和濃度依賴性，將吸附物與溶解物總量守恆。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Contaminant pathway and treatability, Check Kd and concentration dependence in batch and column tests and balance sorbed plus dissolved mass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把高遲滯因子解讀為已除污會漏掉未來脫附。 在「污染路徑與可處理性」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Interpreting high retardation as cleanup overlooks later desorption. Mark where this error can enter the Contaminant pathway and treatability flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 被土壤吸附的污染物已從系統永久消失。~Sorbed contamination has permanently vanished from the system.
units.practice: 只將 Kd 改成 1.0 L/kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3.66667 變成 6.33333 dimensionless。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Kd to 1.0 L/kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 3.66667 to 6.33333 dimensionless. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 天然與增強生物作用~Natural and enhanced biological activity
units.mechanism: 以封閉資料集比較有、無生物活性對照，避免把稀釋或揮發誤當降解。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。~Compare biologically active and inactive controls in a closed dataset to avoid mistaking dilution or volatilization for degradation. A first-order model makes conversion rate proportional to current concentration; log concentration is approximately linear in time.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. Applicability: Constant environment and availability with no new source; this does not predict a real completion date.
units.verify: 針對「天然與增強生物作用」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Natural and enhanced biological activity, Fit multiple time points, hold some out and inspect late-time deviations from first-order behaviour. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「天然與增強生物作用」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Natural and enhanced biological activity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 前兩點符合一階衰減就保證所有後續時間也符合。~Agreement with two early points guarantees first-order decay at all later times.
units.practice: 只將 k 改成 0.07 d⁻¹，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 36.7879 變成 49.6585 mg/L。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only k to 0.07 d⁻¹, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 36.7879 to 49.6585 mg/L. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 電子供受體收支~Electron donor/acceptor balance
units.mechanism: 把污染反應和天然競爭受體分開列帳，本題只練電子當量，不提供現場投藥設定。 電子當量收支連結供體與受體；天然競爭受體及生物可利用性會改變實際需求。~Account separately for target reactions and natural competing acceptors; this exercise teaches electron equivalents without field dosing. Electron-equivalent balance links donor and acceptor; natural competing acceptors and bioavailability change real demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：需移除污染物 n=20 mol；假想每 mol 需 e=4 mol 電子；供體每 mol 可提供 d=8 mol 電子。公式 donor=n*e/d，計算得 10 mol donor。適用邊界：抽象計量例，不指定現場藥劑或注入量；未含背景氧化還原需求。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Contaminant removal n=20 mol; assumed e=4 mol electrons per mol contaminant; donor supplies d=8 mol electrons/mol. Formula donor=n*e/d gives 10 mol donor. Applicability: An abstract stoichiometric example without field reagent or injection dosing; background redox demand is omitted.
units.verify: 針對「電子供受體收支」，同時量供受體、轉化中間產物及地球化學指標，分辨移除、轉化和吸附。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Electron donor/acceptor balance, Measure donors, acceptors, intermediates and geochemistry to distinguish removal, transformation and sorption. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只量母污染物下降可能漏掉更具風險的中間產物。 在「電子供受體收支」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Parent-compound decline alone can miss hazardous intermediates. Mark where this error can enter the Electron donor/acceptor balance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 母污染物濃度降低就保證所有轉化產物都無害。~Lower parent concentration guarantees all transformation products are harmless.
units.practice: 只將可利用供體電子數 d 改成 6，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 10 變成 13.3333 mol donor。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only usable donor electrons d to 6, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 10 to 13.3333 mol donor. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 供應物輸送與反應區~Amendment delivery and reaction zone
units.mechanism: 在教學含水層中比較水流速度與反應區位置，檢查供應物能否抵達受污染的低滲透部位。 孔隙平均流速為 Darcy 通量除有效孔隙率；污染遲滯與彌散另需處理。~Compare pore velocity and reaction-zone location in the teaching aquifer, checking access to contaminated low-permeability regions. Mean pore-water velocity is Darcy flux divided by effective porosity; retardation and dispersion require separate treatment.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：K=1e-4 m/s；水力梯度 i=0.01；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25。公式 v=K*i/ne*86400，計算得 0.3456 m/d。適用邊界：飽和均質含水層、層流，非裂隙運移預測。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: K=1e-4 m/s; hydraulic gradient i=0.01; effective porosity ne=0.25. Formula v=K*i/ne*86400 gives 0.3456 m/d. Applicability: Saturated homogeneous aquifer and laminar flow; not a fractured-flow prediction.
units.verify: 針對「供應物輸送與反應區」，將估算流速與示蹤到達、地層和水頭場比較，列出各參數範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Amendment delivery and reaction zone, Compare estimated velocity with tracer arrival, stratigraphy and heads, listing parameter ranges. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「供應物輸送與反應區」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using Darcy flux directly as pore velocity understates travel speed. Mark where this error can enter the Amendment delivery and reaction zone flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 地下水孔隙流速永遠等於水力傳導係數 K。~Pore-water velocity always equals hydraulic conductivity K.
units.practice: 只將 ne 改成 0.20，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.3456 變成 0.432 m/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only ne to 0.20, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.3456 to 0.432 m/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 接觸時間與水力限制~Contact time and hydraulic constraints
units.mechanism: 以孔隙替換尺度討論供應物接觸，另列混合不均和短流，不能用平均時間保證每處反應。 名目孔隙體積替換時間衡量通量尺度，污染物脫附與低滲透區釋放可持續更久。~Use pore-volume exchange to discuss contact while separately identifying incomplete mixing and bypass. Nominal pore-volume replacement measures throughput scale; desorption and low-permeability release may persist much longer.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土體 V=1000 m³；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25；抽出流量 Q=20 m³/d。公式 tPV=V*ne/Q，計算得 12.5 d per nominal pore volume。適用邊界：均勻單一域且 ne 已知；不是整治完成時間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Bulk volume V=1000 m³; effective porosity ne=0.25; extraction Q=20 m³/d. Formula tPV=V*ne/Q gives 12.5 d per nominal pore volume. Applicability: A homogeneous single domain with known effective porosity, not remediation completion time.
units.verify: 針對「接觸時間與水力限制」，用示蹤、觀測井與抽出濃度比較捕獲範圍和拖尾，不只計算抽了幾倍孔隙水。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Contact time and hydraulic constraints, Use tracers, monitoring wells and extracted concentrations to assess capture and tailing, not merely pore volumes pumped. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 優先通道可快速換水，但污染仍留在低滲透層。 在「接觸時間與水力限制」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Preferential paths can replace water rapidly while contaminants remain in low-permeability layers. Mark where this error can enter the Contact time and hydraulic constraints flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 抽完一個孔隙體積就代表所有污染物都被移除。~Pumping one pore volume removes every contaminant.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 25 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 12.5 變成 10 d per nominal pore volume。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 25 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 12.5 to 10 d per nominal pore volume. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 微生物動力學與環境依賴~Microbial kinetics and environmental dependence
units.mechanism: 同一一階常數只能描述指定資料範圍；溫度、酸鹼與受體改變時需要重新驗證反應速率。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。~A first-order constant describes only its fitted range; changes in temperature, pH or acceptors require rechecking the rate. A first-order model makes conversion rate proportional to current concentration; log concentration is approximately linear in time.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. Applicability: Constant environment and availability with no new source; this does not predict a real completion date.
units.verify: 針對「微生物動力學與環境依賴」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Microbial kinetics and environmental dependence, Fit multiple time points, hold some out and inspect late-time deviations from first-order behaviour. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「微生物動力學與環境依賴」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Microbial kinetics and environmental dependence flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 前兩點符合一階衰減就保證所有後續時間也符合。~Agreement with two early points guarantees first-order decay at all later times.
units.practice: 只將 k 改成 0.07 d⁻¹，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 36.7879 變成 49.6585 mg/L。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only k to 0.07 d⁻¹, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 36.7879 to 49.6585 mg/L. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 串聯轉化與中間物累積~Sequential transformation and intermediate buildup
units.mechanism: 將母物、中間物和終產物畫成流圖，用莫耳收支確認是否卡在某一反應階段。 串聯反應中間產物的累積是上游生成減下游消耗；只測母物不能判斷完整反應。~Draw parent, intermediate and product flows and use molar balances to identify a stalled reaction stage. Intermediate accumulation in sequential reactions equals upstream formation minus downstream consumption; parent-only analysis cannot establish completion.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：母物轉化 n=10 mol；假設中間物化學計量 y=1 mol/mol；再降解 d=6 mol。公式 intermediate=n*y-d，計算得 4 mol。適用邊界：抽象單一路徑與已知化學計量，不指定實際污染物的毒性或現場處方。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Parent transformed n=10 mol; assumed intermediate yield y=1 mol/mol; subsequent degradation d=6 mol. Formula intermediate=n*y-d gives 4 mol. Applicability: An abstract single pathway with known stoichiometry; no real-compound toxicity or field prescription is implied.
units.verify: 針對「串聯轉化與中間物累積」，以莫耳量核對母物、中間物與終產物，附回收率和未量測支路。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Sequential transformation and intermediate buildup, Reconcile parent, intermediates and products on a molar basis, including recovery and unmeasured branches. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 下游反應受限會在母物已下降時累積中間產物。 在「串聯轉化與中間物累積」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A downstream bottleneck accumulates intermediates even while the parent declines. Mark where this error can enter the Sequential transformation and intermediate buildup flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 母物移除百分比必然等於完整降解百分比。~Parent-removal percentage always equals complete-degradation percentage.
units.practice: 只將後續降解 d 改成 3 mol，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4 變成 7 mol。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only subsequent degradation d to 3 mol, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 4 to 7 mol. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 地球化學與樣品質保~Geochemistry and sample assurance
units.mechanism: 把氧化還原與產物趨勢連結，使用平行樣、空白與保存紀錄檢查採樣改變了樣本的可能性。 平行樣相對百分差衡量重複性，不能單獨揭露共同系統偏差或整個場址異質性。~Relate geochemistry to product trends and use duplicates, blanks and preservation records to test sampling-induced changes. Relative percent difference measures duplicate precision but cannot alone reveal shared systematic bias or site-wide heterogeneity.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：平行樣 C1=18 mg/kg；C2=22 mg/kg。公式 RPD=abs(C1-C2)/((C1+C2)/2)*100，計算得 20 %。適用邊界：同基準且高於定量能力的正值；近零時比例不穩，無預設法定合格門檻。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Duplicate C1=18 mg/kg; C2=22 mg/kg. Formula RPD=abs(C1-C2)/((C1+C2)/2)*100 gives 20 %. Applicability: Positive values on the same basis above quantification capability; ratios become unstable near zero, with no assumed legal acceptance threshold.
units.verify: 針對「地球化學與樣品質保」，搭配空白、加標回收和採樣位置檢查差異來自分析或現場不均。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Geochemistry and sample assurance, Combine blanks, spikes and sample locations to separate analytical variation from field heterogeneity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 兩樣同受污染或同一校正偏差時，RPD 仍可很低。 在「地球化學與樣品質保」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Two equally contaminated or equally miscalibrated samples can have a low RPD. Mark where this error can enter the Geochemistry and sample assurance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 兩個平行樣完全相同就證明結果一定準確。~Identical duplicates prove the result is accurate.
units.practice: 只將 C2 改成 26 mg/kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變成 36.3636 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only C2 to 26 mg/kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 20 to 36.3636 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 停止供應後的反彈~Rebound after amendment cessation
units.mechanism: 在離線模型停止假想供應，檢查殘留污染是否由吸附庫存重新釋出及產物是否持續改善。 停機反彈可能反映低滲透區釋放、脫附或持續源，不等於取樣錯誤。~Stop hypothetical amendment in the offline model and check residual desorption and continued product improvement. Shutdown rebound may reflect low-permeability release, desorption or a continuing source, not merely sampling error.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：停機前濃度 C1=4 mg/L；重啟濃度 C2=10 mg/L。公式 rebound=C2/C1，計算得 2.5 ratio。適用邊界：同一位置與方法的濃度比；不由此比值直接辨識唯一根因。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Pre-shutdown concentration C1=4 mg/L; restart concentration C2=10 mg/L. Formula rebound=C2/C1 gives 2.5 ratio. Applicability: Concentration ratio at the same location and method; it does not identify a unique cause.
units.verify: 針對「停止供應後的反彈」，保留停機時間與多次重啟趨勢，對照水位、流量和空白樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Rebound after amendment cessation, Retain shutdown duration and repeated restart trends, comparing heads, flows and blanks. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只報運轉中的低濃度會掩蓋未移除的污染庫存。 在「停止供應後的反彈」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Reporting low on-treatment values alone hides residual contaminant inventory. Mark where this error can enter the Rebound after amendment cessation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 設備運轉時濃度低就證明停機後也永遠保持低濃度。~Low concentration during treatment guarantees permanently low concentration after shutdown.
units.practice: 只將 C2 改成 7 mg/L，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.5 變成 1.75 ratio。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only restart C2 to 7 mg/L, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.5 to 1.75 ratio. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 多線證據與結案判讀~Multiple lines of evidence and closure interpretation
units.mechanism: 綜合污染物、產物、電子收支和水文變化，將量測不確定度帶入反應成效而非只報母物降幅。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。~Combine contaminants, products, electron balances and hydrology with measurement uncertainty instead of reporting parent decline alone. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
units.verify: 針對「多線證據與結案判讀」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Multiple lines of evidence and closure interpretation, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「多線證據與結案判讀」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Multiple lines of evidence and closure interpretation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 重複量測次數越多，所有系統性誤差都會自動消失。~More repeats automatically eliminate every systematic error.
units.practice: 只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only uC to 0.03, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.072111 to 0.05 relative standard uncertainty. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
